name: adrenaline-list
description: Read-only search of the public Adrenaline List catalogue of adventure activities.

interface.longDescription: Adrenaline List is a directory of adventure activities: bungee jumping, skydiving, paragliding, canyoning, rafting, glacier hiking and 75+ other types. This connector gives the assistant read-only access to the public catalogue. Search by keyword, country, activity type, adrenaline rating (1-10), month and maximum duration. Open any activity for requirements, age limits, member review summary and the operator's public website and booking links. Read Adrenaline List's own rankings, such as the Adrenaline Index. No account or sign-in. Every result links to adrenalinelist.com.
